title: Professional Client Classification for High Leverage (>1:30)
precondition: Client applies for 1:500 leverage under professional status.
steps: 1. Verify MiFID II elective professional criteria.
expected_result: Requires verified portfolio size > €500k and trading activity; non-qualified clients locked to 1:30.
actual_result: Elective professional classification verified under MiFID II criteria; unqualified retail accounts remain locked to 1:30.
